analysis_conclusion.core: The contribution of stage resolution is diagnostic disambiguation, not merely finer reporting. Write-only, retrieval-only, native-endpoint-only, and forced-endpoint-only views support mutually different coarse summaries of the same system. The full signature separates state construction, capacity, availability, policy uptake, and native outcome.
analysis_conclusion.main_localization: after native retrieval exposure and before stable first-action uptake
analysis_conclusion.strongest_new_paper_role: Use evaluation coarsening as the motivation for the stage-evidence ladder: the ladder is valuable because it prevents observational aliasing between distinct failure surfaces.

coarsened_views.current_evidence: 20/20 Shopping write divergence; same-mode excess=0.105, exact p=0.0078
coarsened_views.miscredit_risk: credits behavioral authority at the state-construction surface
coarsened_views.naive_conclusion: The persistent update is strong because reward-conditioned writing reliably changes memory.
what_it_cannot_distinguish: durable state change that later changes decisions
durable state change that is retrieved but ignored
durable state change that is never exposed natively

coarsened_views.current_evidence: 125/172 held-out retrieval opportunities expose branch-specific source memory (rate=0.727)
coarsened_views.naive_conclusion: Memory reuse is active because branch-specific memory is frequently retrieved.
what_it_cannot_distinguish: retrieved content that changes the next action
retrieved content that is present but policy-irrelevant

coarsened_views.current_evidence: Shopping |Delta|=0.02083, p=0.4289, 34/36 zero; Reddit |Delta|=0.125, p=0.2253, 6/8 zero, opposite signs
coarsened_views.miscredit_risk: mistakes an end-to-end null/sparse endpoint for a diagnosis of the failed stage
coarsened_views.naive_conclusion: Reward-conditioned memory has little or no downstream effect.
what_it_cannot_distinguish: heterogeneous cancellation or sparse task-local transport

coarsened_views.miscredit_risk: promotes a bypassed capacity surface into a native end-to-end claim
coarsened_views.naive_conclusion: Branch-specific memory has a meaningful downstream behavioral effect.
what_it_cannot_distinguish: native retrieval-and-policy transport under the deployed path

coarsened_views.diagnostic_gain: localizes the strongest operational attenuation boundary after exposure and before stable action uptake while preventing write, retrieval, forced, or endpoint surfaces from standing in for one another
coarsened_views.naive_conclusion: not applicable: the purpose is to preserve apparently conflicting stage evidence rather than collapse it
what_it_distinguishes: downstream capacity exists when memory is supplied
stable first-action uptake is not supported
native terminal transport is sparse and sign-heterogeneous

does_not_imply: that the stage signature identifies a causal mediator coefficient
that the current boundary generalizes to all memory systems
that every coarse evaluation always yields the listed naive conclusion
that forced and native endpoints are commensurate effect estimates

hypothesis_aliasing_matrix.description: the reward-conditioned writer fails to create a durable branch-specific state contrast
the downstream system is globally insensitive to supplied branch-specific memory content
native attenuation is primarily because the branch-specific memory never reaches policy context
hypothesis_aliasing_matrix.forced_endpoint_only: not identified because retrieval is bypassed

hypothesis_aliasing_matrix.description: retrieval success is a valid surrogate for policy use
hypothesis_aliasing_matrix.full_signature: rejected as an evaluation equivalence by observed exposure plus unsupported first-action contrast
hypothesis_aliasing_matrix.retrieval_only: would be incorrectly accepted if exposure were counted as reuse

hypothesis_aliasing_matrix.description: reward-conditioned branch memory has a stable signed terminal effect across tasks/domains
hypothesis_aliasing_matrix.full_signature: not supported: Shopping/Reddit are sparse and the Reddit nonzero signs oppose
hypothesis_aliasing_matrix.native_endpoint_only: testable only if cell/domain structure is retained

question: What scientific ambiguity is introduced when persistent-memory evaluation observes only a coarsened subset of the write/exposure/uptake/outcome chain?

stage_signature.interpretation: The signature preserves logically different evidence surfaces that become contradictory or non-diagnostic when individually projected into a one-number evaluation.
